`FTD3XX.dll` 1.3.0.4: FTDI's D3XX user-mode library for FT60x USB 3 bridges (the BladeCam2 uses one),
copied from DataRay's installation. It ships next to `beamscope.exe` in the installer so the camera
works without depending on DataRay's program folder. The BladeCam2 USB driver itself is still installed
by DataRay's software. FTDI's drivers are free to redistribute with products that use FTDI devices.
